summary: Re-tested multi-outlet isolation focusing on Product global (outlet_id=NULL) fixes after models.py nullable=True + ALTER TABLE DROP NOT NULL migration. All 6 previously failing Product-global cases now pass, plus full regression on user/outlet/shift/login/sales flows. 19/19 tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >2600 lines — recommend splitting into routers (products, sales, outlets, admin/users, shifts). File-size guideline breach.
Product create endpoint: Admin passing outlet_id=None correctly returns 400 (spec-compliant). Consider also validating outlet_id='' from Admin as 400 for consistency (currently untested for Admin).
Global product visibility via anonymous GET /api/products?outlet_id=X correctly UNIONs outlet-scoped + NULL-scoped products. Good.

Regressions on shift open, login cascade, outlet soft-delete, sales+stock-movement, dashboard, settlement all pass. rca of the issue: Previous iteration_20: Product.outlet_id had NOT NULL constraint + DEFAULT 'outlet-sudirman' at DB level, so passing NULL was silently coerced or rejected. Fix applied: (1) models.py Column(String(36), nullable=True) with no default; (2) startup migration ALTER TABLE mjd_products ALTER COLUMN outlet_id DROP NOT NULL + DROP DEFAULT; (3) create_product rewrote to route outlet_id in (None, '', 'all') through Super-Admin-only global branch, else falls back to admin's outlet with 400 if Admin explicitly requests global. Verified via POST returning outlet_id=null and GET /api/products?outlet_id=X including the NULL-outlet row.
